verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a risk register fed by a NIST risk library, and Comply AI for Risk produces inherent risk scores, treatment plans, and residual risk scores, so scored risks with treatment plans are covered. The evidence does not show risk owners, recurring risk review cycles (the recurring reviews cited are for vendors, a different feature), or risks being linked back to controls. missing for 10: documented risk owners, recurring risk review cycles, risk-to-control mapping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls

citations.quote: Organizations can easily add these risks to their risk register for tracking.
Comply AI for Risk automates the risk assessment workflow by producing inherent risk score, treatment, residual risk score, and justifications.
Using a risk description, Comply AI for Risk produces an inherent risk score, treatment plan, and residual risk score
